maria (PeopleOps): Quick pack — six micro-prompts to warm up for OKR self-reviews. Can folks skim & say if these are usable in 1:1s?

maria (PeopleOps): 1) What progress this quarter most surprised you? (1 line)
2) One concrete data point that shows progress
3) Where did you over/underestimate effort? (1-2 bullets)
4) Biggest blocker still unresolved and next step
5) One stretch win you want to repeat
6) One skill you want to grow next quarter

aj (Eng Manager): Nice. Can we add 'impact on customers or metrics' after #2? Simple append.

leo (SWE): Short and clear. Maybe #3 -> 'effort vs estimate' — w/examples?

maria (PeopleOps): Good call. Updated: #2 -> 'data point + metric/customer impact'. For examples, keep outside of core prompts: e.g., 'metric: +15% retention; customer: reduced latency for X'

sam (Talent Partner): Love this. Could you also add a manager prompt pack — 3 quick coaching phrases that map to growth/comp? Eg "Keep doing: X", "Try: Y", "Support: Z"

maria (PeopleOps): Yep adding manager micro-templates:
- Keep doing: one sentence that names a behavior and why it matters
- Try: one small experiment or boundary to expand scope
- Support: one concrete request (time, pairing, feedback)

okrbuddy-bot: Suggested copy for manager templates saved to /playbooks/okrs/compact-manager-phrases.md :gear: 

aj (Eng Manager): This is gold. I'll paste the one-liners into my 1:1 agenda.

leo (SWE): Same — making these my prep notes. Thanks!

maria (PeopleOps): Thanks all. I'll drop a short microcard in the docs and a Slack shortcut. If anyone wants a 1-page printable, ping me.

sam (Talent Partner): Pinged — would love a printable version for coaching sessions :thumbsup:

maria (PeopleOps): Noted. Will do by EOD Friday.
